origin: Design prepared after user accepted 60/60 Sony source/output translation review; no new device A/B run has been supplied.

ab.control: whole: one ML Kit 17.0.3 SDK translate() of two-sentence source paragraph
ab.candidate: linewise: translate two newline-separated sentences independently and join strings with a single space
ab.models: Same preloaded ML Kit offline models; neither configuration is a different neural translation model
ab.alternating_order: Each sample yields two complete outputs, i-even whole/linewise and i-odd linewise/whole
ab.device: Sony SO-03L Android 11 arm64 if available; inference offline, Wi-Fi off + airplane mode verified by existing Windows PowerShell harness
ab.thermal: Battery sensor (not SoC die); initial below 40C, abort when >=43C, stop after 10 min total elapsed

preregistered_before_any_output.critical_error_veto: No new NEGATION_ERROR or NUMBER_OR_NAME_ERROR compared to whole paragraph
preregistered_before_any_output.reviewer: Manual paired rating of both full target paragraphs, no status prefills, model outputs locked
preregistered_before_any_output.outcome: PROMISING only if every condition passes, then test again on second truly unseen set. No production switch from this test alone.

human_review_ui: tools/t10_translation_strategy_ab_review.py generates standalone offline review.html (side-by-side cards with save/re-import CSV), device raw SHA pin and immutable raw columns.
caveats: New dataset differs in unit (two-sentence paragraphs) from original single-sentence CP4 gate; cannot transfer acceptance gate automatically.
No machine-generated model improvement or measured acceptance yet.
Human reviewer agreement in original 60 does not certify this new dataset.
Segment isolation may lose pronoun context and increase latency; do not assume candidate wins.
Android CI and Python evaluator tests must run; Sony output not in repo.
